data.content_ref: inline:Abstraction: SRC_009's depth-conditional support-chain closure abstracts SRC_003's local closure by parameterizing inheritance depth, so an attack at depth d inherits to the warrant's target only when the support chain is itself accepted under the warrant filter. Refuted if there is a depth-d attack that inherits under the abstracted rule while its support node is OUT in the inner labelling, so the abstracted closure attacks a target through a defeated support.
